notes: εἰς (s017) left unrepresented: the ASV writes 'was made the head of the corner' with no preposition, so nothing answers to it and rule 36's absorbed-into-a-predicate case applies; rule 21 forbids leaving a bare 'the' on it.
οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες → 'the builders' split under rule 32, the article taking the determiner the ASV wrote; rule 90's one-word case does not apply, two English words standing.
οὗτος → 'The same' headed on 'same' under rule 17's generic-completion clause, the Greek being anarthrous so that the supplied 'The' is a rule 51 helper.
Rule 37 is not in question: the whole Psalm citation is translated within this verse.
